messages.text: IF-009 counts confirmed in code. POST /api/backup/export answers { fileName, directory, companies, diagnoses, actions, diaryEntries, questionnaireSends, brand, reevaluationInterval }; POST /api/backup/import answers { imported, skipped }, each with the same seven numeric keys. brand and reevaluationInterval are 0 or 1 (skipped.brand = 1 means the file had a brand but this installation already has its own). Types are in src/api/backupApi.ts, server/services/backupService.ts and server/validation/backupSchemas.ts.

src/features/settings/BackupSection.tsx still shows only companies and diagnoses. The owning frontend unit (phase-7-frontend-backup) should show actions, diaryEntries, questionnaireSends and, if wanted, a notice for brand / reevaluationInterval kept out of skipped.

tests/e2e/support/fixtures.ts importBackup (around line 249) spreads an exported backup and replaces companies and diagnoses. It still works with a version 2 file because the other lists travel along, but the e2e author should know the file is now version 2.
